author: Grace Hall
title: 'Most Incompetent': Trump Backs Biden Autopen Inquiry - NewsBreak
text: President Donald Trump has backed an investigation into former President Joe Biden’s use of autopen signatures on important documents, including presidential pardons. The review, spearheaded by the White House Counsel’s Office with support from the Department of Justice, will scrutinize over one million documents to determine the extent of Biden’s involvement and evaluate whether current policies adequately govern the use of autopen signatures. The inquiry comes amid ongoing Republican concerns regarding an alleged lack of transparency regarding the administration’s handling of official documents. White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt stated that Joe Biden was the worst, most incompetent, and senile president in the country’s history. Leavitt added that it has been widely reported that Joe Biden handed the power of the presidency to an autopen controlled by unelected leftist staffers, who were allowed to make terrible decisions that destroyed the country. Leavitt added that the Trump White House is committed to finding the answers to the many outstanding questions the American people still have about how business in the Biden White House was conducted. The National Archives holds many thousands of documents, prompting concerns over accountability in executive actions. Investigators found that nearly all documents bearing Biden’s signature in his final months were signed using autopen. One message from Biden Chief of Staff Jeff Zients reportedly read that he approves the use of the autopen for the execution of all following pardons. Biden notably issued pardons for Dr. Fauci and Gen. Milley, allegedly meant to shield them from potential Trump retaliation. The inquiry now examines his mental fitness and the role of unelected officials under his leadership. Grace Hall covers U.S. politics & news for content partner Modern Newsstand LLC.
